name: Re:VIEW (Japanese TeXLive + Ruby)
description: Installs the Re:VIEW publishing toolchain equivalent to vvakame/docker-review: Japanese TeXLive, MeCab, pandoc, PlantUML, Playwright system deps. Ruby gems (review, etc.) are managed by Gemfile via bundle install.

installPlaywright.description: Install Playwright via bun and Chromium system deps for screenshots / Vivliostyle PDF.

installFonts.description: Install Noto CJK / emoji fonts for Playwright / Vivliostyle rendering.
